annotations.title: Smart contract risk check: proxy, bytecode and supply red flags for a Base contract before approving it

description: Check a Base contract before you approve or call it: a low to critical risk tier with named flags (proxy, proxy with no implementation, tiny bytecode, zero token supply), plus bytecode size, the EIP-1967 implementation slot and ERC-20 owner, renounced and paused reads. Unreadable reads are null; EOAs return not-applicable. Limited heuristics, not a full security audit. Use before approving a spender or calling an unfamiliar Base contract. Example: address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
